subject.title: ci: stress race detection with a GOMAXPROCS sweep and repeat count

question: Should every push and pull request pay for approximately 20 race-suite executions, or should the full GOMAXPROCS/repeat sweep run on a reduced or scheduled cadence?
rationale: Correctness and proof are strong, but repository policy cannot determine the acceptable ongoing GitHub Actions cost and flake budget.

options.title: Schedule full stress sweep
options.body: Keep required CI lightweight and run the complete GOMAXPROCS 2/8, count-5 sweep on a scheduled or manually dispatched workflow.

options.title: Accept full recurring sweep
options.body: Merge as written and explicitly accept the increased Ubuntu and macOS runner usage on every workflow.

options.title: Reduce repetitions
options.body: Retain both GOMAXPROCS values on every run but lower the repeat count to balance scheduling coverage and CI cost.

recommendation.title: Schedule full stress sweep
recommendation.body: Keep required CI lightweight and run the complete GOMAXPROCS 2/8, count-5 sweep on a scheduled or manually dispatched workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide CI budget and cadence decision rather than a line-level correctness repair.
